$comment: Operations schemathesis is allowed to exercise against LIVE staging.
Opt-in only. A new endpoint is NEVER added automatically - it must be reviewed and listed here.
Excluded by policy: anything that sends email, takes payment, deletes data, writes catalog,
changes auth state, uploads media, or calls an external service (Google Play, DeepSeek).
Full-spec coverage including mutating operations runs against the Prism mock, not staging.
